verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Proactive alerts & triggers" as a product feature. Ari proactively messages users when something moves, and connected Google Sheets automatically update the Model when the file changes, so some event-driven automation exists. Nothing documents user-defined rules, conditions or configurable actions, so the story's "define rules" element rests on a bare pricing-page line item. Missing for 10: documentation of user-authored trigger rules (conditions, events, actions), a configuration UI or API for rules, a range of triggerable action types beyond alerts and syncs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
